method: Three serial rotated repeats per build and position, 100k nodes and 200ms. Release NPS is authoritative. Counter and clock builds are measured separately; clocks perturb tiny scopes. Logical copy payload is 408 bytes/update (256 float lanes + 152 feature metadata), read+write double that; not measured DRAM traffic. Delta rows count one perspective; both perspectives are included in byte estimates. Unused updates mean a frame never evaluated directly; unused leaves additionally had no evaluated descendant. Pending rows are uncancelled sums since the nearest evaluated ancestor (root already materialized), not an implemented lazy algorithm or measured speedup.
